description: Portal foundation: rebase onto the current base, single-head migration 0011 (auth_users.customer_id + CHECK, portal_user_grants, portal_payment_attempts) with ORM mirrors, settings, error codes, the exclusive `customer` role and customer_id claim, provisioner guard, driver-grant refusal, central default-deny (HTTP middleware E1/E2, get_tenant_context E1b, WebSocket E3), the portal guard (PortalScope, require_portal_customer, principal checker, reject_scope_params), portal_audit module + middleware, per-user rate-limit helpers, the CORS Idempotency-Key header, GET /api/portal/me, and the route-inventory test harness that later FEATs extend. Design sections: Codebase facts, 1.1-1.3, 1.5, 1.6, 2.1-2.3, 3 (router conventions), 3.1, 8, 9, 11. Everything later depends on this FEAT.
steps: 0. Base sync. The branch is 5 unpushed docs commits ahead of and 25 behind origin/production-readiness/go-live-blockers (base moved: OI-41 transition_order_guarded in fuel/services/order_service.py, OI-02 dyed-diesel fail-closed, OI-18, errors/codes.py additions). Run `git -C <wt> fetch origin`, confirm `git -C <wt> ls-remote origin production-readiness/customer-portal` is empty (unpushed), then `git -C <wt> rebase origin/production-readiness/go-live-blockers`. If the branch HAS been pushed, use `git merge --no-ff origin/production-readiness/go-live-blockers` instead (never rewrite pushed history). Confirm `alembic heads` still shows only 0010_acct_override_audit; if another 0011_* exists (margin-feed may land first), re-parent per design §9 (bump id/filename; never a merge revision).

1. Settings (Runsheet-backend/config/settings.py): add customer_portal_enabled=False, portal_read_rate_limit=120, portal_order_rate_limit=10, portal_order_cancel_rate_limit=10, portal_payment_rate_limit=5, portal_max_users_per_customer=10, portal_principal_cache_seconds=60, portal_stale_reading_days=7 (ints ge=1) and a model_validator that logs WARN 'customer_portal_enabled without commerce_backbone_enabled; portal stays off' (never raises). Add CUSTOMER_PORTAL_ENABLED=false to Runsheet-backend/.env.example and {"name": "CUSTOMER_PORTAL_ENABLED", "value": "true"} next to COMMERCE_BACKBONE_ENABLED (~line 1592) in Runsheet-backend/scripts/staging_aws.sh. Do not touch .env.staging.

2. Error codes: add the 15 codes of design §11 to errors/codes.py ErrorCode and ERROR_CODE_STATUS_MAP with the listed HTTP statuses, plus factory helpers in errors/exceptions.py following resource_not_found/insufficient_role.

3. Migration alembic/versions/20261008_0001_customer_portal.py: revision='0011_customer_portal', down_revision='0010_acct_override_audit' (or the current head per step 0). upgrade(): auth_users.customer_id VARCHAR(64) NULL + CHECK ck_auth_users_customer_binding exactly as design §1.3 + partial index ix_auth_users_tenant_customer; portal_user_grants (§1.4, email CITEXT: run `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext` first, uq_portal_grant_active_email partial unique, ix_portal_grant_customer); portal_payment_attempts (§6.1 columns, CHECKs, UNIQUE stripe_payment_intent_id, uq_ppa_idem, partial unique uq_ppa_inflight, ix_ppa_customer). downgrade() drops in reverse. Add PortalUserGrantORM and PortalPaymentAttemptORM to persistence/models.py matching the migration.

4. Identity (design §1.1, §1.2, §1.5, §1.6): auth/supertokens_init.py add 'customer' to CANONICAL_ROLES, CUSTOMER_PORTAL_ROLE, STAFF_ROLES; leave CUSTOMER_ASSIGNABLE_ROLES unchanged; _lookup_auth_user_claims selects customer_id and emits claims['customer_id'] only when non-empty. ops/middleware/tenant_guard.py: TenantContext gains customer_id: Optional[str]=None (last field), _build_context gains customer_id kwarg, _context_from_session_claims coerces it like driver_id and stamps request.state.auth_user_id. auth/test_auth.issue_test_context gains customer_id kwarg. auth/provisioner.py: AuthUserRow.customer_id, _build_metadata includes it, provision_user raises ValueError('invalid_customer_binding') before any SuperTokens write when the §1.3 invariant is violated. fuel/api/driver_endpoints.py: PostgresAppAccessUnitOfWork.read_row selects customer_id; AppAccessService.grant refuses a customer row with 409 APP_ACCESS_ALREADY_LINKED and audit outcome rejected:customer_identity. Update tests that pin CANONICAL_ROLES only to add 'customer'.

5. Central deny (design §2.2): new Runsheet-backend/portal/__init__.py and portal/scope.py with PORTAL_ROLE, PORTAL_PATH_PREFIX, CUSTOMER_ALLOWED_EXACT, customer_session_verdict(), portal_enabled(settings). middleware/auth_enforcement.py: after _has_verifiable_session is True, read memoized claims via a _verified_claims(request) helper and return _forbidden_response(request, code) (403, same JSON shape as _unauthorized_response) + WARN portal_audit outcome=forbidden_route with collapsed path. get_tenant_context: same verdict -> AppException(code). bootstrap/websockets._resolve_ws_claims: customer claims -> WARN portal_audit (channel=websocket) and return None.

6. Audit + rate limits (design §8): portal/audit.py emit_portal_audit (logger 'portal_audit', extra_data convention of services/csv_export.py, field allowlist) and PortalAuditMiddleware (paths /api/portal/ and ^/api/commerce/customers/[^/]+/portal-users; one line per request; outcome map; Cache-Control: no-store) registered in main.py immediately before _register_auth_enforcement. portal/api/_authz.py: portal_rate_key, PORTAL_READ_LIMIT/ORDER/CANCEL/PAYMENT limit strings built from settings like EXPORT_RATE_LIMIT. main.py: add 'Idempotency-Key' to CORSMiddleware.allow_headers. Keep main.py <= 200 effective lines (169 now): if the routers push it over, mount the portal routers through one `portal.api.routers` tuple import.

7. Portal guard (design §2.3): portal/api/_authz.py PortalScope (frozen, rejects empty ids), require_portal_customer (flag -> require_role 'customer' -> identity shape -> principal check -> request.state stamps incl. export_tenant_id/export_user_id -> PortalScope), reject_scope_params router dependency. portal/services/principal.py PortalPrincipalChecker (grant join via auth_users.st_user_id, CustomerService.get, in-process cache keyed (tenant,user,customer_id) with TTL portal_principal_cache_seconds and injectable clock, invalidate_user(), first_seen_at set once, fail-closed 503 PORTAL_UNAVAILABLE never cached), configured from bootstrap/core.py only when CustomerService exists.

8. GET /api/portal/me (design §3.1): portal/models.py PortalMe (extra='forbid'); portal/api/me_endpoints.py with the shared read limit; ordering_available via a new public OrderIntakePipeline.get_ordering_state(tenant_id) wrapping _get_overlay_state; invoices_available from commerce flags + configured invoice service; payments_available via portal.services.portal_payment_service.portal_connector(tenant_id) which in this FEAT is only the configure_portal_payments(connector_factory=None, payment_service=None) registry and returns None when unconfigured (FEAT-005 fills it in). Mount the portal router in main.py (unconditionally).

9. Test harness + tests in new package Runsheet-backend/tests/portal/ (__init__.py, conftest.py): a real-auth fixture that stubs services.elasticsearch_service in sys.modules like tests/smoke/test_route_smoke.py, imports main.app, forces auth_provider='supertokens', installs configure_session_verifier/configure_ws_session_verifier fakes from claims (never override_auth), and per-role session factories (cA, cB in demo-tenant; cC in qa-tenant-b; STAFF_ROLES). Write: test_portal_central_deny.py (XR-1 full route inventory with handler spy, XR-2, XR-3, XR-5), test_portal_ws_deny.py (XR-4), test_portal_staff_deny.py (XR-6 iterating every /api/portal/* route dynamically so later FEATs are covered automatically), test_portal_flag_off.py (XR-8 both parametrizations, dynamic inventory), test_portal_audit.py (AUD-1 generic over every matched route), test_portal_rate_limits.py (RL-1 + T-RL-COVERAGE over every /api/portal/* route), test_portal_cors.py (PAY-13 preflight), test_portal_principal.py (PRV-5), test_portal_scope.py (ISO-C-4, ISO-T-2 query part via reject_scope_params), tests/unit/test_supertokens_claims.py::test_customer_id_claim (PRV-4) plus customer not in CUSTOMER_ASSIGNABLE_ROLES, test_app_access_refuses_customer.py (PRV-3), provisioner guard unit test, and tests/postgres/test_portal_schema.py::test_customer_binding_check (PRV-2, [pg], unique tenant ids, cleans its rows).
acceptance_criteria: `alembic heads` lists exactly one head (0011_customer_portal or its re-parented successor); upgrade -> downgrade -1 -> upgrade succeeds on the scratch DB and `python -m scripts.check_migrations` passes

A customer session gets 403 PORTAL_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN on every mounted non-public, non-allowlisted HTTP route with the handler never called, and every WebSocket handshake closes 4001 (XR-1, XR-2, XR-4 pass)
Mixed-role or claimless customer sessions get 403 PORTAL_IDENTITY_INVALID on staff and portal routes (XR-5, ISO-C-4 pass)
Every staff role gets 403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE on /api/portal/me with the flag on; with portal off or backbone off it is 404 PORTAL_DISABLED (XR-6, XR-8 pass)
/api/portal/me returns the PortalMe shape with ordering_available=false when the overlay state is disabled and payments_available=false when no portal factory is configured

Existing suites (tests/unit/test_driver_app_access_endpoints.py, tests/unit/test_tenant_scope_authz.py, tests/unit/test_ws_supertokens_auth.py, tests/smoke) pass unchanged apart from adding 'customer' to pinned role lists
main.py effective line count <= 200 and docs/endpoint-registry.md has no diff after regeneration
